notes: Emits four top-level topic keys (characters, star_system, resonance, sacred_hall) because characters.md covers all four and each already exists as its own top-level key in knowledge.json. Folding them into 'characters' would break the live schema.
'aka' arrays present on live character entries are deliberately omitted: characters.md does not state any aliases.

MAJOR CONFLICT: this source describes an 8-star ladder (skill Lv4 at 8 stars, [All] buff at 7 stars). Live star_system says max_stars 7 with star 7 giving both a stat boost AND skill Lv4. One of the two is wrong; not resolved here.
CONFLICT: this source gives Dracoola and Loki a star-up buff at 4 stars only, while live records them at stars 1, 4 and 7 like every other hero.
CONFLICT: live sacred_hall says it is levelled with currency from Abyssal Tide; this source says Upgrade costs Character Shadows and Build costs Abyssal Stonework.

Source is internally inconsistent on the Rare roster: the section header says '6 documented' and lists 6, but its closing note says 'The 7 documented heroes appear to be the complete Rare roster.' Left unresolved; only the 6 actually listed are emitted.
Unicode minus/en-dash characters in the source were normalised to ASCII hyphen. No numeric values were altered.

characters._coverage: Source documents 6 Rare, 6 Epic and 5 Legendary heroes. Source states more Epic and Legendary heroes likely exist beyond those catalogued.
characters.rarity_tiers: Heroes are grouped into three rarity pools: Rare, Epic, Legendary. Each pool contains different heroes.
characters.rarity_is_fixed: Each hero is locked to one rarity and never ascends tiers (Otta is always Legendary, Alex is always Rare).
characters.rarity_vs_power: Rarity does not directly imply power. A fully-leveled lower-rarity hero can outperform a low-star higher-rarity hero.

characters.acquisition_daily_rewards: Daily Rewards Bonus Pack gives random shards for the selected hero (default Phynx); shard quantity scales with rarity (x1 70%, x2 25%).
characters.acquisition_limited_offers: Limited Offer packs supply event/seasonal hero shards.
characters.acquisition_event_only_heroes: Nezha and Wukong are obtainable only during their corresponding limited-time events.
characters.acquisition_not_from_chests_or_hunt: Hero shards do NOT drop from Mythstone or Chromatic Chests, and do NOT drop from Hunt. Chests give gear; Hunt gives gear, runes, gear scrolls, gold and EXP only.
characters.shards: Heroes are unlocked and starred up with shards, shown as an 'X/Y' counter on the hero card (X/150 and X/100 counters observed). Sources: Daily Rewards Bonus Pack, Limited Offer packs, events. Not Hunt.
characters.shard_exchange: Excess hero shards convert one-way into Character Shadows, not into other heroes' shards.
characters.unique_skill_kits: Each hero has one named signature ability set that levels across 4 tiers as the hero stars up. The kit name is unique per hero.
characters.outfit_button: The Outfit button on the hero portrait is where skins and cosmetics are applied to the hero.

star_system.how_stars_are_earned: Stars are unlocked by collecting hero shards (the 'X/150' or 'X/100' counter on hero cards).

star_pattern.1: [All] unique buff (global stat bonus applying to every hero you own)
star_pattern.8: Hero's unique Level 4 skill (MAX, final form)

star_system.skill_level_unlocks: Skill levels unlock at stars 0/2/5/8 - four power steps per hero's signature kit.
star_system.all_buff_unlocks: [All] buffs unlock at stars 1/4/7 - three per hero, each a permanent global bonus across the account.
star_system.resonance_unlocks: Resonance unlocks at 3 stars, with a second slot at 6 stars.
star_system.all_buff_meaning: The '[All]' prefix on a star-up bonus means it applies to every hero you own, not just the hero being starred up. Examples: '[All] CRIT DMG REDUC +15%', '[All] CRIT Rate +4%'.
star_system.strategy: Because 1/4/7 star bonuses are account-wide, even heroes you never plan to play are worth starring for the global buffs.

resonance.unlock_at: 3 stars grants slot 1; 6 stars grants slot 2.
resonance.how_it_works: Resonance lets your active hero pull the unique skill and skill level of another unlocked hero, one per slot.
resonance.character_skills_row: 2 slots total. Slot 1 unlocks at 3 stars, slot 2 at 6 stars. Each holds another hero's signature kit at whatever level you have unlocked on the source hero.
resonance.skin_skills_row: 4 slots total, fixed count, unlocked progressively via Sacred Hall privileges ('+1 skin talent(s) of character in Resonance slot #N'). Once unlocked, fill with skin talents from any character.
resonance.resonance_section: The Resonance section below the slots lists the cumulative effects of everything currently equipped across both rows.
resonance.max_loadout: A 6-star hero with Sacred Hall progress can wield their own kit + 2 borrowed hero kits + 4 borrowed skin skills simultaneously.
resonance.strategic_implication: Resonance makes building multiple heroes deep valuable even if you only play one. Levelling secondary heroes and starring up skins unlocks stronger things to resonate into your main.

sacred_hall.access: Reached from the Sacred Hall button on the hero portrait. A building structure providing global ATK and HP bonuses plus account-wide privileges.

sub_tabs.upgrade: Spend Character Shadows (purple gem currency) to raise Sacred Hall level and apply privileges to the existing structure.
sub_tabs.build: Spend Abyssal Stonework (blue currency) to build/expand Sacred Hall. Separate track from Upgrade.
sub_tabs.display_case: Cosmetic showcase for up to 6 characters of your choice.

sacred_hall.two_tracks: Build and Upgrade are two distinct progression tracks using two different currencies. Both are needed to fully advance Sacred Hall.
sacred_hall.side_panel: The Upgrade view side panel has Overview (full privileges list, cumulative plus upcoming unlocks) and Shard Exchange.
sacred_hall.building_stats_example: ATK +5,000 and HP +20,000 at Lv. 46; the next-level preview showed ATK +5,800, HP +25,000.
privileges_observed: Main hero can activate +1 skin skills (raises the cap on simultaneously active skin skills)
Main character can inherit +1 skin talent(s) of character in Resonance slot #1
Main character can inherit +1 skin talent(s) of character in Resonance slot #2
Max Energy +20 / +10 (multiple instances stack the cap)
Skin Collection Stats +15% / +30% (recurs at multiple tiers)
Max deployed Mystlings in Peak Arena, Arena, Guild Expedition +1 (recurs)
sacred_hall.shard_exchange: Overflow hero shards convert into Character Shadows at a 1:1 ratio, with a 'Salvage All' bulk option. Character Shadows feed the Sacred Hall Upgrade track, so excess hero shards become Sacred Hall progress.
sacred_hall.strategic_implication: A slow, permanent power-floor raise. Every hero benefits, and privileges like energy regen, scroll/gold gain and max energy make every other system more efficient.
sacred_hall.skin_collection_stats_note: Skin Collectible Stats are static (always-on for every owned skin, not equipped-gated). Source believes the Sacred Hall +15%/+30% multiplier most likely applies to ALL owned skins' Collectible Stats account-wide, but flags this as unverified.
